svg.title: Gameplay feature implementation evidence
svg.desc: 17 of 20 tracked systems observed working with bounded evidence; 3 partially verified; 0 not yet verified. Unverified does not mean unimplemented. Not overall completion.
svg.text: 20 tracked systems. Native observations establish bounded implementation evidence.

g.title: Movement, jumps and net climbing: observed-bounded — Normal running, jumps, wall jumps and roof crawling through Pinna5; not every movement state. Source: pinna-normal-route.md#complete-normal-ferris-wheel-milestone
Camera control and first-person aiming: observed-bounded — Normal coaster aiming and camera use; not every camera mode or scene. Source: pinna-normal-route.md#complete-normal-mecha-bowser-milestone
FLUDD spray nozzle: observed-bounded — Controller-only Gatekeeper, Petey and Ricco routes exercise ordinary spraying and water use. Source: normal-world-routes.md

FLUDD hover nozzle: observed-bounded — Normal nozzle swaps, Hover transfers and landing brakes complete Pinna3 and Pinna5; not every fuel or collision edge case. Source: pinna-normal-route.md#complete-normal-ferris-wheel-milestone

FLUDD rocket nozzle: observed-bounded — Normal Bianco Rocket acquisition, save, full-trigger launch and landing, with fresh-process saved-right reload; global Delfino unlock and other interactions remain open. Source: rocket-turbo-gameplay.md

FLUDD turbo nozzle: observed-bounded — Normal Episode6 leaf-boat/shore access, Turbo acquisition/save, trigger charge, observed speed85.6 and water consumption, then fresh-process saved-right reload; not every collision, door, race or global Delfino unlock. Source: bianco-turbo-progression.md#completed-episode6-turbo-milestone

Goop removal and collision: observed-bounded — Normal airport and Delfino Gatekeeper progression exercises spray removal and gameplay collision; later goop variants remain open. Source: normal-world-routes.md

Enemy and boss combat: observed-bounded — Normal Gatekeeper, Petey and his Bianco5 rematch, Gooper Blooper, Mecha Bowser, Cannon, five Pinna4 turtles and the Pinna5 Ferris-wheel boss; not all enemies or bosses. Source: normal-world-routes.md; pinna-normal-route.md#complete-normal-ferris-wheel-milestone

Grabbing, throwing and pulling: observed-bounded — Normal bomb handling and boss/object interactions; not every carryable object. Source: pinna-normal-route.md#complete-normal-cannon-and-block-secret-milestone
NPC dialogue and minigames: observed-bounded — Normal crate games and paid Pianta throw produce saved rewards; not every NPC script. Source: pinna-normal-route.md#earned-prerequisites-2026-10-19
Gold, red and blue coin rewards: observed-bounded — Hundred-coin reward, two normal sewer blue coins and Pinna3 eight-red-coin reward; not all coin identities. Source: pinna-normal-route.md
g.text: Gold, red and blue coin rewards

g.title: Shine collection and reward flow: observed-bounded — Eighteen distinct normally earned Shines are saved and cold loaded, including Bianco windmill red-coin Shine3 and Petey-rematch Shine4; not all 120 Shines. Source: bianco-turbo-progression.md

World entry and episode selection: observed-bounded — Normal earned prerequisites, cannon entry and Pinna Episodes 1–5; later progression remains open. Source: pinna-normal-route.md#complete-normal-ferris-wheel-milestone

Moving platforms and pirate ships: observed-bounded — Normal Pinna2 blocks, Pinna3 ships and a rising Pinna5 gondola-roof ride; descending-roof carry parity and other platforms remain open. Source: pinna-normal-route.md#complete-normal-ferris-wheel-milestone

FLUDD-less secret stages: observed-bounded — Normal Pinna2 secret completion and saved Shine31; other secret stages remain open. Source: pinna-normal-route.md#complete-normal-cannon-and-block-secret-milestone

Card save and fresh-process load: observed-bounded — Eighteen-Shine GCI and normally saved Bianco Rocket right, seven valid sector checksums and normal cold reload; not every recovery/error path. Source: bianco-turbo-progression.md

Yoshi riding and abilities: observed-bounded — Normal Pinna feeding, riding, tongue/refill/colour change, flutter, juice spray and dismount, plus permanent Delfino unlock/save/cold; other Yoshi interactions remain open. Source: yoshi-gameplay.md

Death and restart lifecycle: partial — Normal death returns to Delfino are recorded; the combined transitions/death/restart/save lifecycle gate remains open. Source: normal-world-routes.md; ../../ROADMAP.md#open-work-in-order

Graphics, menus and HUD: partial — Owner-confirmed early picture and controls plus bounded rendering fixes; later scenes and full visual quality remain open. Source: clean-pc-test-2026-10-19.md; playability-matrix.tsv

Music, sound effects and movies: partial — Owner-confirmed sound on the private Clean-PC candidate; later-world/refill/death audio and full coverage remain open. Source: clean-pc-test-2026-10-19.md; playability-matrix.tsv

svg.text: Source: gameplay-features.tsv. This is a curated list, not a count of C++ functions.
Unverified does not mean missing code. Counts are not overall game completion.
